jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Network Design & Optimization
jobs.description: Who we are Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world’s first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation. The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations. About the role Network Design & Optimization (NDO) is a highly cross-functional, strategic, and instrumental function within Gatik. The team is responsible for planning and maintaining networks / routes for Gatik’s Autonomous Vehicles (AVs). The NDO team provides the critical link between business and technical functions within Gatik. The team collaborates across various functions including Commercial, Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and Product. We are looking for an individual to become an integral part of this team. The individual will be responsible for leveraging their strong quantitative, strategic thinking and creative skills to help Gatik scale Freight-Only Operations and meet rising demands of our customers. The individual will work across functions, and enable the NDO team in meeting its broad mandate. In this role, your learning, growth and responsibility will be directly influenced by you. We are a small yet highly effective team where ownership, collaboration and communication skills are highly desired. If you are such an individual, we'd love to talk to you. This role is 5 days a week at our Santa Clara, CA office location. What you'll do Collaborate with a team of business, technical, product and operations individuals to design and optimize Gatik’s Autonomous Networks. Drive the implementation and scaling of tools, capabilities, and processes necessary to achieve goals of the NDO team. Analyze the network data of customers and prepare optimized networks and corresponding commercial proposals Structure complex problems, analyze large amounts of data, and deliver insights and recommendations to the Gatik leadership team. Support the B2B sales cycle including data analysis, network design, routing, scheduling and proposal drafting Lead end to end projects within Gatik and external stakeholders to collect and compile information in support of business strategy and operations. Explain business requirements to technical team members and ensure product development alignment with team vision and goals Conduct research and analysis of industry, company, customer, and channel data to support market assessment and identification of key trends / opportunities. Communicate analysis and recommendations to stakeholders including external senior executives by preparing presentations and identifying actionable insights What we're looking for Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related science discipline. MBA preferred. 5+ years of work experience in a strategic, analytical and/or customer facing role. Consulting, Banking, and/or a start-up experience preferred. Hands on experience problem solving and implementing scalable solutions to complex problems within a rapidly changing environment Proven ability to analyze data, develop creative solutions, and make sound decisions under pressure. Excellent proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Data analytics tools. Data modeling / scripting skills with Python strongly preferred. Comfortable using AI tools to automate workflows. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively interact with stakeholders at all levels. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and managing ambiguity, ability to multitask and prioritize conflicting demands. Salary Range - $170,000 - $220,000 More about Gatik Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the first and only company to achieve fully driverless middle-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability. We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology - an integration of software and hardware - to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point-to-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik’s well-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations. Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles. We are diverse in our backgrounds and perspectives yet united by a bold vision and shared commitment to our values. Our culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect and agility. We at Gatik strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that together we can do great things. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. jobs.title: Manager, Starlink Engineering (Starlink PCBA SMT)
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. MANAGER, PCBA SMT ENGINEERING (STARLINK) SpaceX is developing a low-latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of people around the world. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. To enable our goal of “Connecting the Unconnected,” SpaceX is ramping up production of our User Terminal Kit manufacturing facility in Bastrop, Texas (Greater Austin), which will bring hundreds of high-skill manufacturing jobs to the area. SpaceX is also leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. We are looking for a hard-driving and well-rounded leader, capable of taking charge of a broad array of responsibilities associated with developing and growing a new production organization. You will be responsible for building out the production team that will operate and maintain this equipment. You will be responsible for establishing the standards by which this team operates, and shepherding the program from the startup phase into a disciplined production organization. This individual must have the capability to rapidly become a subject matter expert on multiple complex production operations. You must be capable of operating successfully within a chaotic startup environment while identifying and executing on actions needed to ensure mission success. RESPONSIBILITIES: Manage, recruit, and develop a team of manufacturing engineers, lead engineers, and specialists for Starlink PCBA manufacturing. Set technical standards and hold the team accountable for delivery. Lead manufacturing development strategy for SMT/PCBA, including capacity, line architecture, and process capability. Own quality, delivery, cost, yield, and equipment performance at high-volume throughput. Own factory layout, material flow, equipment, tooling, spares, and build-process strategy from receiving through test, including capital spend, vendor selection, and automation justified by ROI. Drive new products from design into production. Own NPI readiness, process qualification, and rate ramp, and influence design for manufacturability and testability (DFM/DFT). Align daily with production, design, test, supply chain, and quality. Serve as the escalation path for line issues and drive root cause to permanent corrective action. Define production data, SPC, and MES/MRP/ERP requirements. Keep process, equipment, and training records current. Ensure a strong focus on safety and ESD control and maintain an excellent safety record. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline 5+ years of experience in one or more of the following: Electronics development and/or production SMT production 2+ years of experience leading a team of 10+ individuals as direct reports PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Master's degree in an engineering discipline. Previous experience managing a team of high-performing manufacturing engineers and/or specialists. Proficiency in electronics manufacturing processes and equipment, including screen print, SPI, pick-and-place, reflow, AOI/AXI, selective solder or wave, coating, and test, plus a strong working knowledge of EEE piece parts, PCB, PCBA, and high-reliability electronics assemblies. Experience with design of experiments, gauge repeatability and reproducibility, and yield improvement. Ability to communicate clearly from the floor to senior leadership and to operate in a highly adaptive, iterative environment. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed Able to travel up to 10% on an ongoing basis ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .
